principles: One lifecycle fact must have one executable predicate and every readiness surface must consume it.
Preflight must fail closed with the same stable machine-readable code as DONE.
Readiness inspection must remain read-only and must never repair reviewer evidence.
The fix and its tests must remain narrowly bound to the proven mismatch.
drivers: The existing real DONE predicates are already exported or directly reusable.
The reviewed behavior test proves two concrete divergence paths without relying on source-text assertions.
Process-fact policy requires registry and verifier coverage whenever gate evidence consumption changes.

options.name: Reuse existing predicates in done-oracle
pros: Keeps reviewer semantics sourced from evaluateReviewVerdict
cons: Adds explicit core dependencies to done-oracle and requires careful error-code mapping

options.name: Duplicate finish and reviewer checks in done_prepare
pros: Localized edit in the preflight handler
cons: Creates a second implementation that can drift again

options.name: Extract a new aggregate DONE predicate module
pros: Could centralize more DONE logic over time
Can produce one aggregate verdict API
cons: Substantially expands scope beyond the two proven predicates
Raises regression risk and requires broader lifecycle refactoring

rationale: Directly reuse readDevMemoryFinishDecision and evaluateReviewVerdict while building the shared DONE checklist. This is the smallest design that removes semantic duplication, gives done_prepare the real verdict, preserves its read-only behavior, and leaves unrelated DONE predicates unchanged.

preMortem.scenario: The new review row maps every reviewer failure to stale_closeout_review.
preMortem.trigger: A missing round or blocking finding is evaluated.
preMortem.consequence: done_prepare emits the wrong recovery code and diverges from DONE again.
preMortem.mitigation: Map only review_evidence_invalid to stale_closeout_review and preserve every other evaluateReviewVerdict code verbatim; test the stale hash case exactly.

preMortem.scenario: done_prepare changes reviewer evidence while checking freshness.
preMortem.trigger: The stale diffPackHash fixture is evaluated.
preMortem.consequence: Preflight fabricates freshness or changes git state.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep buildDoneChecklist read-only and assert reviewer evidence bytes plus git status are unchanged.

preMortem.scenario: The behavior test exists but is omitted from validation.
preMortem.trigger: A future refactor removes one row while ordinary tests still pass.
preMortem.mitigation: Register the executable test in proof-or-stop.config.json and add process-fact verifier and flow-stability checks.
